record.body:
## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria: validate manifests through Claude's real entry point, confirm README matches, and note a short install dry-run checklist.

## Approach

1. Run `claude plugin validate .` in the phase worktree (integration entry point).
2. Confirm marketplace.json has both plugin names and plugin.json dependencies include adaptive-artifacts.
3. Confirm README Claude path is single marketplace add; Cursor path has no false auto-dep claim.
4. Record a short dry-run checklist in the execution-report body (marketplace add → install se-workflow → AA enabled, or the refuse message if environment cannot install).
record.subject: verify-plugin-dep-marketplace
